import sys, hashlib
disk = open('/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(disk.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')
f = sys.argv[1]; sel = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
s = open(f'/tmp/r28rev/{f}.sh').read()
body = s.split("<<'EOF'\n", 1)[1].rsplit('\nEOF', 1)[0]
if f == 'c59':
    lines = body.split('\n')
    i = next(k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('r27 = open(_p.__file__)'))
    j = next(k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('SRC = dict(r27=r27, cand27=cand)'))
    lines[i:j + 1] = ["live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()",
                      "assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')",
                      "SRC = dict(r27=live, r28=open(_p.__file__).read())"]
    body = '\n'.join(lines).replace('rev27k_', 'rev29k_')
elif f != 'c26':
    assert body.count("startswith('5683ff7b')") == 1, f
    body = body.replace("startswith('5683ff7b')", "startswith('e5dc8ef0')")
if f == 'c45' and sel:
    if sel == 'Q2':
        body = body.replace("for name in ('BLOCKING', 'ATTACK', 'BOUNDARY'):", "for name in ():")
    else:
        body = body.replace("for name in ('BLOCKING', 'ATTACK', 'BOUNDARY'):", f"for name in ({sel!r},):")
        body = body.replace("for args, pages, people, allowed in R24.cases.matrix(): yield 'Q2', pages, people, allowed", "pass")
if f == 'c28' or f in ('c29', 'c30'):
    pass
print(f'{f} {sel or ""}: columns = live r28 (send-merge e5dc8ef0) | r29 (disk 866637df); labels inside are stale')
sys.argv = [f] + sys.argv[3:]
exec(compile(body, f, 'exec'), dict(__name__='__main__'))
